name: crescent-pharma-platform
description: Crescent Pharma Compliance Platform — unified 21 CFR Part 11 compliant software for laboratory instruments

scripts.package:mac: npm run configure:mac -w @crescent/desktop && npm run package:mac -w @crescent/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @crescent/shared -w @crescent/licensing && npm run build -w @crescent/license-authority -w @crescent/server -w @crescent/web -w @crescent/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build:modules && npm run test -w @crescent/licensing -w @crescent/module-ph -w @crescent/module-tlc -w @crescent/server -w @crescent/desktop
scripts.build:module:ph: npm run build -w @crescent/module-sdk && npm run build -w @crescent/module-ph
scripts.build:module:tlc: npm run build -w @crescent/module-sdk && npm run build -w @crescent/module-tlc
scripts.build:modules: npm run build -w @crescent/module-sdk && npm run build -w @crescent/module-ph -w @crescent/module-tlc
